zh-CN.Knowledge Base Cleanup Before Launching: Knowledge Base Cleanup Before Launching A Chatbot
zh-CN.A chatbot will expose every stale articl: A chatbot will expose every stale article, duplicate policy, and unclear owner in a knowledge base. Cleanup should happen before model tuning.
zh-CN.The practical reason this topic is getti: The practical reason this topic is getting attention in 2026 is simple: companies are turning help centers and internal wikis into AI answer surfaces. For support, success, and IT teams preparing a chatbot launch, the question is no longer whether the trend is interesting. The question is where it changes daily work enough to justify new process, budget, or risk review.
zh-CN.The common failure mode is blaming the m: The common failure mode is blaming the model for contradictions that already exist in source content. That mistake usually happens when a trend is treated as a feature checklist instead of an operating change. The technology may be new, but the weak point is often ownership, permissions, data quality, recovery, or review.
zh-CN.Before picking a vendor or writing code,: Before picking a vendor or writing code, decide which articles are authoritative, stale, duplicated, or missing. A clear first decision keeps the team from mixing experiments, production systems, sensitive data, and customer promises into one blurry rollout.
zh-CN.Start small: archive old content, assign: Start small: archive old content, assign owners, and tag source quality before indexing. Keep the first version narrow enough that success and failure are both visible. That makes it easier to compare quality, cost, latency, privacy, and support load before expanding the workflow.
zh-CN.A mature workflow produces a knowledge b: A mature workflow produces a knowledge base inventory with owners, freshness, and chatbot eligibility. It should be easy for someone outside the implementation team to inspect what happened, understand why it happened, and decide whether the result is reliable enough to act on.
zh-CN.Set a review date, a measurable success: Set a review date, a measurable success criterion, and a rollback path before launch. If the knowledge base cleanup workflow does not improve the actual decision, reduce risk, save time, or create a clearer user experience, keep it in research instead of forcing it into production.
zh-CN.Define the use case for knowledge base c: Define the use case for knowledge base cleanup before choosing tools.
zh-CN.Name the main risk: blaming the model fo: Name the main risk: blaming the model for contradictions that already exist in source content.
zh-CN.Make the first decision explicit: which: Make the first decision explicit: which articles are authoritative, stale, duplicated, or missing.
